summary: Apply the final SELinux context: stop `pulpcore.service`, unmount `/var/lib/pulp/pulpcore_static` and `/var/lib/pulp/`, change the `/var/lib/pulp` fstab line to `context="system_u:object_r:pulpcore_var_lib_t:s0"` and run `mount -a`.
